title.zh: normify 依赖图修复：死依赖改指 verified 后继 / 伞卡下游改指收口卡 / Linux 政策编码为依赖 / 占位卡统一 note（只改任务记录，零 GPU）
title.en: normify dependency-graph repair: abandoned deps to verified successors, umbrella placeholders to closeout deps, Linux policy encoded as a dependency, placeholder notes (task records only, GPU-free)

intent.zh: Chief 2026-11-11 批准治理提案 4 点后执行一条 planning 卡：① 17 个开放任务的 65 条 abandoned 依赖边按 abandoned 卡自身「放弃/依据」改指 62 条到 verified 后继；② a06-p10（执行图，代码/测试已交付无卡）在 p10/p11 上 waive + note；③ t4-artifacts（用户 2026-10-23 裁决 B，无后继）drop 死边 + 在 next-t4-numeric 追加 2026-10-27-t4-historical-capture-rebaseline-decision；④ r06-p8/r10-p8 家族已收口 → 下游对占位伞卡的依赖改指已验证收口卡（r06-flex-closeout / r05-r09-r10-family-closeout），占位卡本身保持 proposed；⑤ Linux 政策编码为依赖（p1/d02/d03/d03-final/p11/layers-linux/np03-dual-platform/np04-performance → 2026-10-24-linux-batch-retest）；⑥ 53 张零检查开放卡加 note（45 张阶段占位统一措辞 + 8 张 deferred/backlog 变体措辞），不参与就绪判定。只改 .normify 任务记录的依赖/note；不改任何卡 acceptance/scope/status/owner，不 start/不 verified 占位卡，不碰判据/参考/spec/fixtures/src/tests 与 W0 冻结输入。零 GPU、不采集、不开窗；前后对照表与统计入证据。
intent.en: Execute one planning card after Chief's 2026-11-11 approval of the four governance recommendations: repoint 62 abandoned dependency edges across 17 open tasks to the verified successors named in each abandoned card's own rationale; waive the a06-p10 edge on p10/p11 (code/test delivered, no card) with a note; drop the t4-artifacts dead edge and add the T4 rebaseline decision dependency on next-t4-numeric; repoint downstream deps from the already-closed umbrella placeholders r06-p8/r10-p8 to their verified family closeout cards while leaving the placeholders proposed; encode the Linux policy as a dependency on 2026-10-24-linux-batch-retest for the eight Linux-touching tasks; add notes to the 53 zero-check open cards (45 uniform stage placeholder wording + 8 deferred/backlog variant). Only .normify task records (dependencies/notes) change; no acceptance/scope/status/owner change; no placeholder start or verify; no criteria/reference/spec/fixtures/src/tests change and no W0 frozen inputs touched. GPU-free; before/after table and stats go to evidence.

acceptance: 范围：只改 .normify 任务记录的 schedule.depends_on 与 note；不改任何卡的 acceptance/scope/status/owner；不 start/不 verified 任何占位卡；不碰判据/参考/spec/fixtures/src/tests 与 W0 冻结输入。
死依赖：17 个开放任务的 65 条 abandoned 边中 62 条改指 verified 后继（依据逐条可追溯）、2 条 waive（a06-p10）、1 条 T4 例外（drop + 追加 2026-10-27-t4-historical-capture-rebaseline-decision）。
伞卡与政策：r06-p8/r10-p8 的下游依赖改指已验证家族收口卡（5 条）；Linux 政策依赖 8 条（→ 2026-10-24-linux-batch-retest）；占位卡 note 53 张（45 统一措辞 + 8 变体），g10-p5/r07-p8 保持 proposed。
完成判据：normify status 0 个开放任务依赖 abandoned、0 错误 0 警告；verified 数不因本卡异常变化；证据含前后对照表（任务/旧依赖/新依赖/依据）与统计；manifest 自核、编码卫生。
非声明：只是排程图修复；不构成阶段验收、不改变判据/参考、不宣称任何功能完成。
note: 按原有任务声明重建进行态。此登记不新增验收结论。
